items.context: @BitcoinArchive (1.796.043 seguidores): "MARKET MAKER BUYS $600M IN BITCOIN AT $58,650 AVG • Abraxas Capital tracked by Lookonchain • Moved BTC off multiple exchanges 👉 They seem confident the bottom is in!" (con video). Post de ~15 min con 74 likes, 14 reposts, 9 respuestas y 11462 vistas, creciendo rápido.
items.suggested_text:
Moving $600M off exchanges at a $58,650 average is a statement of intent, but one buyer's conviction isn't the same thing as a confirmed floor. Bottoms tend to show up in the aggregate, not in a single wallet.

The cleaner read is cost basis: when price trades near or below the realized price, MVRV approaches 1 and the average holder is roughly at breakeven. Those zones have historically been where long-term holders absorb supply from the ones capitulating. Add price vs the 200-week average, drawdown from the high and momentum, and the market already reads ice cold: my Market Temperature index went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days.

Cold doesn't mean finished, though. The lowest readings usually last longer than anyone buying the first dip expects.
